name: tayyari
description: Tayyari: hyper-personalized career intelligence. Resume + GitHub + Lovable + links -> skill graph -> Claude-powered career chat, with Jev decisions. React frontend + Python (FastAPI) backend in backend/.

scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory backend python -m tayyari.cli dev
scripts.start: uv run --directory backend python -m tayyari.cli serve
scripts.demo: npm run build:static && uv run --directory backend python -m tayyari.cli serve
scripts.deploy: npm run build:static && uv run --directory backend python -m tayyari.cli deploy --skip-build
scripts.smoke: uv run --directory backend python -m tayyari.cli smoke
scripts.make-sample: uv run --directory backend python -m tayyari.cli make-sample
scripts.ingest-check: uv run --directory backend python -m tayyari.cli ingest-check
scripts.lint:py: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check .
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:palette && npm run check:restraint && npm run check:build && npm run check:portfolio
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run lint:py && npm run typecheck:py && npm run test:py
